list.title: Organizations
list.intro: Work that belongs to a group rather than to you. Members reach it through the teams the organization gives its spaces to.
list.none: You are not part of any organization yet.
list.emptyTitle: An organization owns spaces on behalf of a group.
list.emptyBody: Put people on its roster, group them into teams, and give a team a space. Joining the team is then the only thing anybody has to do to reach the work.

invitations.heading: {count, plural, one {You have an invitation} other {You have # invitations}}

restricted.hint: You reach only what somebody there granted to you directly.
restricted.leaveBody: You lose whatever it granted you. Somebody there can invite you again.

create.title: New organization
create.body: You own it. Add people to its roster afterward and put them on teams.
create.bodyWithLimit: You own it. Add people to its roster afterward and put them on teams. This Polaris allows up to {limit} members.
create.handleHint: Used in links. Cannot be one an account already signs in with.

overview.nothingYet: Nothing has been done here yet.

activity.title: Activity
activity.intro: Everything done to {org}: its people, its teams, its roles, its domains and its work. What somebody does on their own account is not here.
activity.empty: Nothing has been done here yet.

billing.title: Billing
billing.intro: What {org}'s projects used each month, priced at this Polaris's rates, and the budget it is measured against.
billing.empty: This organization has no projects yet. A project created while it is the open shelf belongs to it.

budget.title: Monthly budget
budget.noPrices: This Polaris has no prices set, so the statement shows usage only and there is nothing to measure a budget against.
budget.whoIsTold: The people who run this organization's settings are told when a month reaches {thresholds} of it.
budget.otherCurrency: This budget was set in {was} and prices are now in {now}. Set it again in {now} to keep it measured.
budget.removeBody: Nobody will be told when this organization's spending passes 80% or 100% of a month.

domains.title: Domains
domains.intro: Domains {org} owns, so its services answer on its own name rather than this Polaris’s.

spaces.emptyBody: Switch to {org} in the header, then create a space in Tasks. It will belong to the organization rather than to you, and outlive anybody leaving.
spaces.reachedBy: {count, plural, one {# task} other {# tasks}} - reached by {teams}
spaces.openToRoster: {count, plural, one {# task} other {# tasks}} - open to everybody on this roster
spaces.noTeam: {count, plural, one {# task} other {# tasks}} - no team reaches it yet
spaces.footer: A team reaches a space because it was granted it, which is done from the space’s own access settings in Tasks.

people.title: People
people.leaveBody: You will lose everything its teams gave you.
people.removeBody: They come off every team here as well, and lose what those teams reached.
people.sendAgainFailed: {reason} Copy the new link from Invite somebody.
people.withdrawEmailBody: The link stops working at once. They are not told.
people.withdrawAccountBody: They are not told. You can invite them again at any time.

invite.title: Invite somebody
invite.notEmailed: The invitation was made but could not be emailed. Copy the link below.
invite.sent: Invitation sent. They will see it when they next sign in.
invite.full: This Polaris allows {limit} members per organization, counting invitations nobody has answered.
invite.rolesHint: What this role may do is set under <roles>Roles</roles>.
invite.newPeople: An email with no account behind it gets a link that creates the account and joins them here.
invite.existingOnly: Only people who already have an account can be invited from here.
invite.linkHint: Hand this link over yourself. It works once and expires in 7 days.
invite.defaultRoleLabel: The role new invitations offer by default

teams.title: Teams
teams.empty: A team is what a space is given to. Nothing here reaches any work yet.
teams.deleteBody: Everybody on it loses whatever this team reached. The work itself is untouched.
teams.full: This Polaris allows {limit} teams per organization.

create.title: New team
create.body: Give it people, then give it a space in Tasks. Everybody on it reaches that space.

panel.description: {description} Everybody on it reaches whatever it has been given.
panel.defaultDescription: A team in {org}. Everybody on it reaches whatever it has been given.
panel.nobody: Nobody is on this team yet.
panel.addHint: They have to be on the organization already. {hint}
panel.nothing: Nothing yet. A space is given to a team from that space's own access settings in Tasks.

roleHints.member: Reaches everything the team has been granted.
roleHints.maintainer: The same, plus adding and removing the team's own people.

roles.intro: A role decides what somebody may do across this organization. Who holds which is set under <people>People</people>.
roles.deleteNobody: Nobody holds it, so nobody loses anything.
roles.deleteSome: {count, plural, one {# person becomes} other {# people become}} a Member, and lose whatever this role gave them.
roles.locked: Holds everything here, including anything a later version of Polaris adds. This is the role that keeps the organization runnable, so it cannot be narrowed.
roles.restrictedNone: Reaches only what is granted to them directly - not the roster, the files or internal work.
roles.restrictedSome: {held} of {total} permissions, without seeing the roster, the files or internal work.
roles.plainNone: Sees the organization and whatever their teams reach, and nothing else.

create.title: New role
create.body: Name it after the job people actually do here. Everybody who holds it sees the organization; what else it reaches is up to you.
create.descriptionPlaceholder: What somebody with this role is here to do

permissions.orgRead: See the organization, its people and its teams
permissions.settingsManage: Change the name, handle, description and photo
permissions.activityRead: Read what has been done here
permissions.peopleManage: Add and remove people, and set their role
permissions.teamsManage: Create teams and run their rosters
permissions.rolesManage: Define what the organization's roles may do
permissions.spacesManage: Create and administer the organization's spaces
permissions.deployManage: Deploy and configure the organization's services
permissions.domainsManage: Add and verify the organization's domains
permissions.vaultManage: Run the shared vault's collections and members
permissions.driveManage: Add to and change the organization's files

chat.title: Chat
chat.label: A chat of its own
chat.hint: Conversations between the people here stay here, apart from the ones they have with everybody else. They switch between the two the way they switch shelves, in the header. Turning this off later puts the conversations back rather than hiding them.

handle.title: Handle
handle.confirmBody: Every link to /account/organizations/{slug} stops working. Anything anybody wrote down has to be updated.
handle.hint: Links already handed out will stop working.

transfer.title: Hand it over
transfer.nobody: Only somebody already on the roster can be given the organization, and nobody else is on it yet.
transfer.confirmBody: They become the owner and you stay on as an admin. Only they can undo it.

danger.title: Delete
danger.body: Deleting takes {spaces, plural, one {# space} other {# spaces}} and {tasks, plural, one {# task} other {# tasks}} with it, along with its teams, roles and domains.
danger.projects: Its {count, plural, one {# deploy project} other {# deploy projects}} go too, and the services they run are stopped.
danger.drive: Its Drive and everything on it go with it.
danger.dialogBody: {spaces, plural, one {# space} other {# spaces}} and {tasks, plural, one {# task} other {# tasks}} are deleted with it, along with its teams, roles and domains.

successor.title: Successor
successor.intro: Somebody who can close this organization if you are gone. They get nothing else: not its work, not its roster, not a way to act as you. Without one, whoever you named on your own account answers for it.
successor.nobody: Nobody. Name somebody here, or on your own account, or this organization cannot be closed once you are gone.

dialog.removeBody: {name} stops answering for {org}. Whoever you named on your own account takes over again, and you can name somebody here at any time.
dialog.search: Search by username, full name, or email address
dialog.warning: They will be able to delete {org} and everything in it. They will not be able to read it, open it, or change anything in it while you are here. This is not a will and does not outrank one.

mailboxes.title: Mailboxes
mailboxes.intro: Addresses this organization has given to its people. They appear in Mail when the person switches to this organization. Nobody here can read them.
mailboxes.empty: None yet. Hand out a company address and it is waiting for its holder the next time they open Mail on this organization.
mailboxes.takeBackBody: {holder} loses it here, along with everything Polaris holds for it: the cached mail, the filters and templates they wrote, the signature and the drafts. The mailbox itself and its mail are not touched, and it can be handed out again.
mailboxes.done: {holder} has it. Its mail is on its way.

validation.enterIdentifier: Enter an email or a username
validation.budgetPositive: A budget has to be more than zero
validation.budgetTooLarge: That is more than Polaris can track

errors.checkDetails: Check the details and try again
errors.checkHandle: Check the handle and try again
errors.checkAmount: Check the amount and try again
errors.noSeparateChats: This Polaris does not offer separate chats
errors.handOver: Could not hand over the organization
errors.resend: Could not send that invitation again
errors.addToTeam: Could not add that person to the team
errors.removeFromTeam: Could not remove that person from the team
errors.noPrices: This Polaris has no prices set yet, so a budget has nothing to be measured against.
errors.saveBudget: The budget could not be saved. Try again.
errors.removeBudget: The budget could not be removed. Try again.
errors.ownerOnly: Only the owner can name who takes this organization over
errors.chooseHolder: Choose who this mailbox is for.
errors.handOut: That mailbox could not be handed out.
errors.takeBack: That mailbox could not be taken back.
